Text.Text: The annex is quiet and your assessment is complete. Hold that guard for the people behind you. You've finished my Invincible trials. I have no further work for you here.
The annex trials require rank 50 in Vibroblade. Reach it, then report back. A good stance comes from training, not a confident entrance.

My trainees sealed the militia annex and kept drilling without command oversight. Recover their drill ledger so I can see what the program has become. Defeat six Invincible Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. I'll give you the Veles Militia Annex Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Invincible.

Here's the Veles Militia Annex Key. Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Invincible Adepts, then return with the Invincible Veles Drill Ledger.

A guard that does not break. Not bravado, not thick armor, not planting your boots because pride won't let you move. A line you hold with a vibroblade until shot, blade, and bad luck have all given up on it. Most who claim the form are lying. The drill floor sorts those out.

My trainees refused the stand-down order and kept the drill program running without oversight. The annex was sealed during the dispute. I can grant access now: use 'Veles Militia Annex' in the Veles Sheriff/Clinic after accepting my key.

Mine. Every adept on that floor either washed out of my program or refused to leave it, and they've drilled my forms every day since, angry. The last curious visitor who wandered in spent a month over a med table. They won't break formation because you ask nicely. Make them.
Defeat six Invincible Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic.
You've defeated six Invincible Adepts. Let me see the Invincible Veles Drill Ledger.
Record recovered. We can trace the orders now. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists control the militia's range relay. Recover it and stop those unauthorized drills. Defeat five Invincible Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Defeat five Invincible Specialists to secure the Invincible Militia Range Relay, then return to me.

Specialists earned rank under me before the shutdown. The pass bar was holding a guard through a full rotation without one scored hit, and all five cleared it. You'll be the first live drill they've had in a year. They have been bored. Bored and good is a bad combination for you.

The relay logs every run on that range: names, times, scores. It's their proof the program still functions without a captain. On my desk it becomes proof of the opposite. Command ignores rumors and respects records, so I collect records.

Open lanes, no cover worth the word, and five blades timing exactly how long your guard holds, because timing guards is what that range is for. Keep your feet moving between lanes and make them re-aim. The range rewards patience. It buries heroes.
Defeat five Invincible Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic.
You've defeated five Invincible Specialists. Let me see the Invincible Militia Range Relay.
Equipment recovered. Their training operation is disrupted. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden holds the annex for the trainees. Take the challenge badge and break that command. Defeat the Invincible Warden in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Scored Challenge Badge; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Veles Militia Annex, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Invincible Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Invincible Scored Challenge Badge.

Sarn. Six years my second. When command pulled the program he stayed inside the gate and I obeyed the order out of it, and neither of us has forgiven the other. He runs that gate exactly the way I taught him: nothing passes that hasn't earned it. He won't pull the blow. Don't pull yours.

Scored challenge badges went to trainees who survived a full challenge rotation against me, personally. Sarn's is the only one etched with a perfect score. While he wears it, he outranks every drill in the annex. When it sits on my desk, the rank comes back where it belongs.

I recommend two companions against the Invincible Warden. Spread the pressure so one person doesn't have to carry the whole fight. You can enter alone, but prepare carefully before you call the challenge.

Defeat the Invincible Warden in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Scored Challenge Badge; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Invincible Warden. Let me see the Invincible Scored Challenge Badge.
Warden defeated. That breaks their enforcement. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four officers still carry my old authority. Recover their challenge chit. Defeat four members of the Invincible Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Defeat four members of the Invincible Inner Circle to secure the Invincible Captain's Challenge Chit, then return to me.

Toma, Verik, Onn, and Pale. Ten years of my mornings went into those four, and they earned every stripe I gave them before they chose the annex over the stand-down order. I'm not neutral about this line and I won't pretend otherwise. Grade them honestly. Beat what I built without insulting it.

A captain's challenge chit. Whoever holds it can demand a graded bout with the captain, any hour, any floor. I surrendered mine the day they sealed the gate, and the circle keeps it as proof the annex still answers to a captain. It does. The wrong one.

You don't beat four overlapping guards with one blade, so don't audition for it. Bring the partners from the gate fight. Drag one guard out of the line, hit the seam he leaves, and reset before the plates close. A circle only breaks from inside a gap. Your job is the gap.

Defeat four members of the Invincible Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Invincible Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic.
You've defeated four members of the Invincible Inner Circle. Let me see the Invincible Captain's Challenge Chit.
Their officers no longer control the authorizations. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the final test of that defense. Defeat her in the Militia Command Room, then report back for your assessment. Defeat the Invincible Master in Viscara, Militia Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Militia Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Invincible Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Finished means no seams. The circle overlapped four guards; Serra is one guard with no gap in it. Blade, shot, flank, feint, she has already turned it before you commit. You will land nothing in your first minute, so spend it learning her tempo while your partners keep her turning. Even a perfect guard faces one direction at a time. That's the entire lesson, if you live to use it.

She stayed because she believed the program was right and command was wrong, and I sealed the gate on her because an order is an order. We've both had years to chew on that. When her guard breaks, the annex stops being a wound and can be a school again. Maybe with her teaching in it. That page isn't written yet. Yours is first.

I took my challenge rotation against her the spring before the shutdown. Best day I ever had with a blade in my hand, and she graded it a fail and helped me off the floor. A captain gets one more failure than his pride can afford, then he stops spending his trainees' respect and sends someone better. Today, better is you.

Defeat the Invincible Master in Viscara, Militia Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Invincible Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The annex is quiet and your assessment is complete. Hold that guard for the people behind you. You've earned the right to train Invincible. Your final payment is ready.
About the assignment, Captain.
I'll defeat six Invincible Adepts.
What exactly is Invincible?
Why is the annex sealed?
Who's holding that drill floor?
Not yet, Captain.
Here's the Invincible Veles Drill Ledger.
Back to the range assignment.
I'll defeat five Invincible Specialists.
What makes these specialists dangerous?
Why does the relay matter?
What's the range like inside?
I need more drill time first.
Here's the Invincible Militia Range Relay.
About the warden.
I'll defeat the Invincible Warden.
Who is Sarn to you?
What's the badge worth?
What happened to the last one who went alone?
Then I wait until I have my two.
Here's the Invincible Scored Challenge Badge.
Back to the circle.
I'll defeat four members of the Invincible Inner Circle.
Who are the four?
What is the chit?
How does a formation like that break?
Not until my people are ready.
Here's the Invincible Captain's Challenge Chit.
About Serra Kel.
I'll face the Invincible Master and report back.
What am I facing in her guard?
Why did she stay behind the gate?
Why isn't this your fight, Captain?
Not yet. Not for this one.
The Invincible Master is defeated. Here's my report.
